metadata.audit_name: Direction C.5.2 -- Calibration Policy Validation and Research Release Gate

inferential_distinctions.nature_of_metric: Model-based probability-like measure comparing observed Sharpe to expected maximum of M independent Gaussian trials.
inferential_distinctions.threshold_095_meaning: Conventional DSR >= 0.95 threshold corresponds to a 5% one-sided evidence hurdle relative to the EVT hurdle (z >= 1.645).
inferential_distinctions.complementary_tail_prob: 1 - DSR is the model-based upper tail probability of random noise matching the observed Sharpe; NOT posterior probability of fraud or falsity.
unverified_assumptions: Assumes trial Sharpe distribution is approximately Gaussian.
Assumes M trials are independent (real backtest iterations are heavily collinear).
True number of historical trials M is unobservable in practice.
inferential_distinctions.profitability_guarantee: Zero guarantee of positive future excess return or out-of-sample persistence.

tier_1_validated_use_cases.conditions: Sample autocorrelation rho_k < 0.15 for all k in 1..10; Ljung-Box Q_10 p >= 0.05; McLeod-Li Q_10 p >= 0.05; N >= 500.
tier_1_validated_use_cases.permissible_inference: Nominal alpha = 0.05 and alpha = 0.01 tests are valid; moving-block bootstrap (L=10) achieves nominal calibration.

tier_1_validated_use_cases.domain: GARCH volatility clustering without serial autocorrelation
tier_1_validated_use_cases.conditions: Linear returns have rho_k < 0.15; Ljung-Box p >= 0.05; McLeod-Li p < 0.05; N >= 500; L in {10, 20}.
tier_1_validated_use_cases.permissible_inference: Block bootstrap successfully preserves volatility clusters; nominal size well-calibrated (empirical size 0.88% at alpha=0.01).

tier_2_sensitivity_required_use_cases.domain: Moderate serial dependence or ambiguous persistence
tier_2_sensitivity_required_use_cases.conditions: rho_1 in [0.15, 0.30] or Ljung-Box p < 0.05 or McLeod-Li p < 0.05.
tier_2_sensitivity_required_use_cases.required_protocol: Mandatory block-length sweep across L in {5, 10, 20}. If significance disappears at L=20, result is flagged as non-robust.
Must evaluate uncentered bootstrap CI alongside asymptotic t-intervals; report sensitivity to extreme candle winsorization.

tier_2_sensitivity_required_use_cases.conditions: Any claim of multiple testing control.
tier_2_sensitivity_required_use_cases.required_protocol: Mandatory reporting of 2D sensitivity grid over M in [1, 150] and sigma_M in [0.30, 1.00]; single point estimates prohibited.

tier_3_prohibited_or_inconclusive_claims.restriction: Prohibition of alpha = 0.05 claims under high serial persistence
tier_3_prohibited_or_inconclusive_claims.rule: If rho_1 >= 0.30 or AR(2) persistence detected, candidate strategies CANNOT claim significance at nominal alpha = 0.05 or alpha = 0.01.
A strategy cannot claim to be independent based solely on rho_1 < 0.30. Ljung-Box Q_10 and McLeod-Li Q_10 tests are mandatory.
Hypothesis tests on partitions with N < 500 daily observations are strictly barred from claiming statistical discovery.

tier_3_prohibited_or_inconclusive_claims.restriction: Prohibition of DSR causal or posterior interpretation
tier_3_prohibited_or_inconclusive_claims.rule: DSR cannot be described as the probability that a strategy is real, or that 1-DSR is the probability of data snooping.

tier_4_unverified_model_assumptions.assumption: Independence of backtest trials in DSR
tier_4_unverified_model_assumptions.reality: Iterated parameter backtests are highly collinear. EVT extreme value theory assumes independence, making true snooping hurdle uncertain.
Moving-block bootstrap assumes stationary joint distribution; bull/bear regime shifts violate covariance stationarity.

tier_4_unverified_model_assumptions.assumption: Transferability of offline test results to execution
tier_4_unverified_model_assumptions.reality: Zero historical backtest result proves live execution viability. Slippage, latency, order routing, and market impact remain unmodeled.

epistemological_distinctions.category_1_mathematical_implementation: Verifies that formulas are correctly computed according to algebraic specifications (e.g. DSR EVT formula, Mertens SE, block bootstrap slicing).
epistemological_distinctions.category_2_synthetic_empirical_calibrati: Evaluates whether nominal error rates match empirical rejections under idealized synthetic data generating processes.
epistemological_distinctions.category_3_historical_strategy_evidence: Empirical performance on historical market data (e.g. V1-V5 backtests). Measures past fit; does not prove future excess return.
epistemological_distinctions.category_4_real_world_execution: Live order execution with genuine exchange latency, queuing, liquidity consumption, and market impact. Offline research cannot prove live viability.
